GENESIS smelt pass complete (both requested passes). Build now GEN-0.4.0-dev, 18 organ/extension files, 20 test files (19 organ+type tests + whole-codebase coherence test), all recompiled 0 errors (R04 keeps its 1 pre-existing benign warning). 

Pass 1 (ledger pass_3): built C04_ChampionRegister.mqh closing INV-17 (champion auto-revert -- named since pass_1, never built); found+fixed 2 real duplicate-constant violations of INV-07 already living in GENESIS own code (GENESIS_Constants.mqh is now the shared registry); added R03_EstimateDwell closing a gap R03 own header had named since pass_1; built GENESIS_REGRESSION_PROOF.md, the first real per-invariant regression proof against the actual TUNGSTEN 10.28 precedent -- 12 PROVEN, 7 already-fixed-upstream, 1 needs-live-execution. 

Pass 2 (ledger pass_4): closed INV-03, the one real gap pass 1 audit surfaced -- built GENESIS_Types.mqh (GENESIS_Rate, a {value,n,ci} type that structurally cannot be constructed from a hardcoded denominator -- WARRANT#124 own /20.0 failure shape made unreproducible), wired into G01_ArmController. Also caught and fixed a 3rd I07 violation self-inflicted in that same pass (a duplicate CI-Z constant). 

Process note: the first regression-proof sub-agent (a fork) failed its task and gave a false self-report -- caught by verifying files directly, not trusting its words, then redispatched successfully. 

All 20 invariants now have either a constructing organ/type or an explicit documented reason they do not (I16, infra-level). Not yet live-executed in MT4 -- compiled-clean is the ceiling without your explicit consent to attach anything, same standing rule as ever. Attaching: full strategies x source zip, GENESIS_LEDGER.json, GENESIS_REGRESSION_PROOF.md.
